content:
sam: Quick sync: SDK PR #1234 (client auth) is blocked on API PR #5678 (auth header change). Console PR #90 needs a helm chart bump and runtime needs a tiny shim for header parsing. Can we coordinate a merge window tomorrow 11:00 PT? cc @maria @kevin @priya

maria: :eyes: I'm on SDK review now, found a couple minor nits. Will push a follow-up patch by EOD.

kevin: I can take API review. Heads up: PR touches auth middleware — we'll need an e2e smoke on staging after merge. Who can run that?

priya: I can run the staging smoke. Put me down. Also console helm bump is trivial, I'll open the chart PR once API is merged.

ops-bot: CI status: SDK#1234 ✅ all checks passing, API#5678 ❌ integration-tests/auth (timeout).

sam: Noted. @kevin any idea why integration tests time out? Locally they passed for me.

kevin: Looks like a flake in the auth integration test. Re-running CI now. If green I'll request your approval @sam. Also let's add a rollback label on console PR for quick revert.

maria: Follow-up pushed to SDK: fixed nits and added a tiny test. Marked `ready-for-merge`.

ops-bot: CI update: API#5678 build restarted — queued.

kevin: CI back green. @sam you ok to approve API? Plan: I'll merge API -> tag redwood-api@v2.1.0-canary -> priya runs smoke.

sam: Approving now. :shipit: Merge at ~11:05 PT works for me. Order: API -> SDK -> console helm bump -> runtime shim release. @jenna please hold canary routing until after smoke.

jenna: Acknowledged. I'll hold canary flags. Will watch logs during smoke. :mag: 

priya: I'll kick off smoke at 11:10 PT and report back here.

maria: After API merges I'll squash SDK and merge. Draft release note: `SDK: bump auth header`

kevin: Merged API at 3349999012.

ops-bot: Release tag created: redwood-api@v2.1.0-canary by @kevin.

priya: Smoke finished: basic auth flows passing. Saw a transient 0.2% error bump on token refresh under load but recovered quickly — within tolerance. Logs: `auth-rotate` spike then stable. Recommend proceed.

sam: Great. Maria, please merge SDK now.

maria: Merged SDK#1234 at 3349999020. Please monitor.

jenna: Canary routing enabled to 10% after SDK merge.

priya: Console helm bump PR opened: #91 — updates chart values to point to redwood-api@v2.1.0-canary.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with release notes and a quick retro tomorrow. If we need rollback, revert the canary tag and open a short postmortem.
